title: Without Delete, Part Status in the part window is greyed out
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Have an active part, part A.
  • Have an inactive part, part B.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In window 2, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  7. Click the part B row.
  8. Click Active under Part Status.
  9. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed for user B.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens: Part Status shows Active picked and both options greyed out, and the title row shows the green "Active" pill.

Step 3:

  • Inactive cannot be picked; Active stays picked.

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 7:

  • Part Status shows Inactive picked and both options greyed out; the title row shows the grey "Inactive" pill.

Step 8:

  • Active cannot be picked; Inactive stays picked.

Step 9:

  • The window closes and part B is still on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S8-R6: “That user sees the Part Status choice in the part dialog disabled (S13-R20).”
  • S13-R20: “When editing, a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, set to the part's saved status. A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the choice disabled.”
  • S13-R3: “When editing, the title row shows the part's saved status as a pill beside the close X: "Active" in green, or "Inactive" in grey.”
